flows.narrative:
Rotation out of the US into the rest of the world. LSEG Lipper shows ~$12.6B leaving US equity funds (first net sales in 3 weeks) while Europe (+$6.7B) and Asia (+$6.4B) absorbed it. Cash/MMFs saw big outflows, global bond funds extended a 10-week inflow streak (+$18.3B), and gold logged a 4th straight outflow. Divergence: BofA EPFR Flow Show shows US in an 11-week inflow streak and EM +$4.5B, vs Lipper's US and EM-equity outflows; the structural 2026 theme is a Great Rotation with the US taking only ~$26 of every $100 of global equity inflows.</narrative>
